title: Restriction of open extension by zero
statement:
For an open immersion $j$, the adjunction unit $M\to j^*j_!M$ is an
isomorphism on pro-etale module sheaves.

proof.text: Apply the existing fixed-scalar full-faithfulness theorem [lem-sfb-finite-extension-by-zero-fully-faithful] with coefficient category ModuleCat (ULift A) and the given open immersion j. It supplies Full and Faithful for ProEtale.openImmersionLowerShriek.

By the definition [def-weil-extension-by-zero], sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero is the composite of the inverse coefficient equivalence on U, fixed-scalar extension by zero, and the coefficient equivalence on X. The outer equivalence functors are fully faithful, and composition preserves full faithfulness. Unfolding this definition and applying the standard functor instances gives Full and Faithful for the intrinsic extension.

Apply CategoryTheory.Adjunction.unit_isIso_of_L_fully_faithful to the actual adjunction sfIntrinsicExtensionByZeroAdjunction of [lem-weil-extension-by-zero-adjunction]. Since its left adjoint is fully faithful, every component of its unit, in particular the component at M, is an isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Existing fullyFaithfulOpenImmersionLowerShriek (lines 85–94), transported through the defining coefficient equivalences, then unit_isIso_of_L_fully_faithful (line 75); F8, 2026-10-18.
